responsibility: Declares the public overlap and bounds checking helpers used for -Wrestrict and related access diagnostics. The interface exposes check_bounds_or_overlap overloads for direct use with a GIMPLE call or with an explicit pointer_query analysis context.
same_name_distinction: Minimal public header that declares the check_bounds_or_overlap entry points for reuse by other diagnostics; unlike gcc/gimple-ssa-warn-restrict.cc, it contains no pass implementation or built-in access analysis logic.
